why_not_january: membership snapshots carry publish_lag_days=5; the 2025-01-27 snapshot only becomes visible_from 2025-02-12, so no session before that can be ingested under PIT membership
notes: Every ingest batch is recorded in its own ingest-*.json; failures were retried and are visible there, never silently dropped.
The 2025-01-02..01-10 report is kept as evidence that membership was not yet visible, not as a failure of the data source.
Alpha158 needs 60 complete sessions before its longest expression is defined; the first 60 sessions of the window are recorded as warmup_insufficient_history.
